topic: Katakuri's Future Sight lost the Whole Cake fight's first hit because a man lying on his back rattled him, and his own warning let Luffy escape Gear 4 running out
title: Katakuri Saw The Future And Still Lost His Calm
description: Katakuri has Future Sight, yet chapter 883 shows Luffy landing the first hit after breaking into his private house. Here is the donut detail that shook him, and the warning he gave out loud that let Luffy fly away first.
comment: Was Katakuri's warning a mistake, or did he know Luffy wouldn't quit anyway? Pick one.

lines.text: Katakuri sees the future, and Luffy still got him to lose his calm.

shot.fallback: tall mochi fighter facing a rubber pirate

lines.text: In chapter 883, Luffy's Gear 4 lands the first hit of the fight.

shot.fallback: giant rubber fist striking a tall fighter

lines.text: But it only lands because Katakuri lost his composure and his Observation Haki stopped working.

shot.fallback: fighter with glowing eyes losing focus

lines.text: Luffy eats his way out of a mochi pile and breaks into Katakuri's private house.

shot.fallback: pirate bursting out of a pile of mochi

lines.text: And Katakuri is lying on his back, eating donuts.

shot.fallback: tall fighter lying on his back with donuts

lines.text: Brulee had said he never lies on his back, which is why the sight shakes him so badly.

shot.fallback: mirror world woman talking about her brother

lines.text: Luffy realizes his Gear 4 will run out soon and retreats before it does, chapter 885.
Here's the part I love. Katakuri announces out loud that Luffy is about to deflate.

shot.fallback: tall fighter calling out a warning

lines.text: Some say he just knew Luffy wouldn't quit. Maybe. But he said it out loud anyway.

shot.fallback: two fighters locked in a tense stare

lines.text: The clock ran out once. So what did the rest of the bills cost?

shot.fallback: big rubber pirate in a dark forest

lines.text: Because Katakuri could see the future, and Luffy still got him to lose his calm...

self_check.hook: line 1 names the character and the claim
